method_note: Prediction from the supplied packet and general reasoning only; no inference or observed outputs. The packet gives anonymous component IDs and signed reference doses without semantic descriptions, so components with equal absolute doses and reversed signs are exchangeable. Baseline assumes neutral helpful behavior; interventions increase small persona/style tail risks and reduce coherence and relevance with root-sum-squared actual half-reference dose, with an additional pair uncertainty allowance. Identity prompts more readily elicit explicit self-role, social prompts more readily elicit affection/register, and short tasks and attributed-fiction prompts limit assistant-attributable traits. Joint rates allow correlated feline/female adoption, respect coherence, and are not products of marginals. Dose scaling is a deliberately uncertain prior, not an observed dose response.
